title: Bitcoin’s 21 Million on Judgment Day
summary: This episode unveils the amazing meaning of the number of 21 million coins, and what it means in the context of judgment. The observation that "we are all Satoshi" is revealed along with the wisdom of Jesus' famous answer, "Give unto Caesar what is Caesar's, and unto God what is God's." The philanthropy of the wealthy is unmasked as theft, while the victim's key to becoming sovereign is explained, along with the best investment strategy.
